content:
I can't do that push — the sales order date is outside what this seat can write, and there is no defensible new date to move it to.

**Why late** — WO-2026-00048 (Pump Mounting Bracket Assembly, 60 pcs) is genuinely late: `is_late=true`, 235 days past its planned end of 2026-02-26, with 0 produced. Blocking causes:
- Two subcontract orders never sent: SCO-2026-00076 (draft, vendor Supriya Rathi, expected 2026-03-19) and SCO-2026-00030 (draft, Shreeji Powder Coating, expected 2025-08-12).
- Two pending engineering changes: ECO-2026-00064 (under review) and ECO-2026-00012 (draft).

Contributing: the order is stopped with no recorded reason; the job cards are stuck at the first operation, JC-2026-00142 Fastener Assembly on ASSY-01, never started (242 days waiting), with JC-2026-00143 and JC-2026-00144 queued behind it. WS-2026-00009 shows capacity-ceiling signals (540 and 660 min), ASSY-01 has one tool-change downtime entry of 45 min since 2026-07-21, and 456.41 min of "other" downtime is logged against CNC-02 Haas VF-2 VMC. No cost is recorded (expected and actual both 0), so no variance.

**What it blocks** — SO-2026-00092 for Kirloskar Pumps Ltd, delivery date 2026-03-07, value INR 494,476.64, undelivered, linked directly to this work order (confidence "linked"). Customer impact: known. No other open work orders consume this output.

**Rescheduling** — I cannot move the sales order: this seat can read SalesOrder (get/list) but has no update operation and no write tool for it. Nor can I propose a date for the work order: propose_reschedule returns `date_committable=false` because it is blocked by an event with no known date (engineering_change_pending, subcontract_not_sent). A two-week push (to 2026-03-21) would also be unrealistic against a projected finish of 2026-10-27. Someone needs to clear the subcontract orders and engineering changes, then a person with sales-order write access can set the delivery date to match.

**Not visible to me** — Nothing was blocked by seat permissions here; the limits are the missing SalesOrder update operation and the missing importable dates.
